# NYSUT

> NYSUT is a union representing 700,000 education and healthcare professionals across New York State, providing advocacy, professional development, and member benefits.

NYSUT serves pre-K-12 educators, school-related professionals, healthcare workers, higher education faculty, and retirees through comprehensive member resources, legal representation, and community support initiatives. The organization is affiliated with the American Federation of Teachers (AFT) and operates as a major force in New York education and labor advocacy.

## Key Topics

- Union membership and benefits
- Professional development
- Member advocacy
- Pre-K-12 educators
- Healthcare professionals
- Higher education faculty

## Organization Overview

- [NYSUT: A Union of Professionals](https://www.nysut.org): NYSUT homepage representing 700,000 education and healthcare professionals
- [About NYSUT](https://www.nysut.org/about): About NYSUT union organization and membership overview
- [Why Union? Why NYSUT?](https://www.nysut.org/resources/special-resources-sites/union-value/why-union): Explanation of union membership benefits and value
- [Representative Assembly](https://www.nysut.org/resources/special-resources-sites/representative-assembly): NYSUT annual convention and representative assembly governance
